name: io.github.raydeoliveira/uvcpipe
title: uvcpipe
description: USB UVC HDMI capture, local MJPEG viewer, and CH9329 serial HID KVM CLI & MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: UVCPIPE_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Polar.sh Commercial Pro key unlocking capture, view, live HID writes, and mcp.

environmentVariables.name: UVCPIPE_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory containing license.json for commercial capture, view, HID write, and mcp modes.

environmentVariables.name: UVCPIPE_POLAR_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Polar.sh API base URL override (HTTPS or loopback HTTP only) for license activation and validation.

environmentVariables.name: UVCPIPE_NO_TCC_PROMPT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 on macOS to fail closed (exit 4) instead of prompting for Camera TCC access.
